signal: Wavetronix is positioning SmartSensor HD as the non-intrusive radar alternative to in-road loops and expanding across regions as the global specialist in radar traffic detection.

email.body1:
John, saw Wavetronix making the case for SmartSensor HD over in-road loops and growing across new regions.

Regional growth usually surfaces more in-market accounts than one team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals quietly go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Wavetronix off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for your Wavetronix region.

As the footprint grows, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most managers cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your territory needs to cover this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Wavetronix.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Wavetronix's reply rate likely compares to other growing tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
John, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything when a region is expanding, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your territory motion? I will tailor it to Wavetronix either way.
